name: Angus McLeod
bio: Angus McLeod hails from Melbourne, where his passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by attending the Australian Grand Prix every year since he was a boy. After a brief stint in the military police, Angus transitioned his skills to motorsport security, initially working smaller events before landing a role with a Supercars team. His meticulous nature and commitment to safety quickly earned him respect. At Brad Jones Racing, Angus oversees all aspects of team security, from trackside operations to protecting the team's assets. He prides himself on being proactive, identifying potential risks before they escalate, and maintaining a calm and professional demeanor even under pressure. His background in law enforcement gives him a unique perspective on risk assessment, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.description: Angus is a solidly built man with a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of double-checking every security protocol, regardless of how routine.
Insists on decaf coffee after midday, believing caffeine impairs his judgment.
